title: 2BR Near DT — Rooftop Deck + Fire Pit + Sleeps 7
description:
✔️ 7 miles to Downtown Nashville — quick rideshare to Broadway
✔️ Rooftop deck with fire pit and city views
✔️ 2 bedrooms, 2.5 baths — sleeps up to 7
✔️ Fun, colorful Dolly’s Disco vibe
✔️ Full kitchen with stainless and stone counters
✔️ Garage parking for 2 and in‑home laundry

The space
• Dolly’s Disco blends playful Nashville flair with easy comfort
• Bright open living area with plush sofa and smart TV for streaming
• Stylish kitchen with island seating — perfect for pre‑show bites
• Head to the rooftop for sunrise coffee or s’mores by the fire pit
• Two private ensuites plus a handy half bath keep mornings smooth

🌅 Indoor & Outdoor Living
• Open living room with mounted smart TV and comfy seating
• Spacious rooftop deck with outdoor fire pit and lounge seating
• Balcony access off main living level for fresh air moments
• Central air/heat for year‑round comfort
• Disco‑inspired touches and fun photo‑worthy details

🛏️ Bedrooms & Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 7)
• This home includes 2 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms.
• Bedroom 1 — Full‑over‑full bunk + twin trundle (sleeps up to 5); smart TV; ensuite with single vanity and walk‑in shower
• Bedroom 2 — Queen bed (sleeps 2); smart TV; ensuite with single vanity and walk‑in shower
• Additional Sleeping — Twin fold‑out bed for flexibility (home sleeps 7 total)
• Half Bath — Convenient hall powder room

🍳 Kitchen & Dining
• Full kitchen with stainless appliances and glossy stone countertops
• Coffee duo: traditional drip + Keurig
• Island seating for casual breakfasts and pre‑show snacks
• Cookware, bakeware, utensils, are provided
• Salt, pepper, and cooking oil are not provided

🏖️ What's Included
• In‑unit/home washer and dryer for longer stays
• We provide bedding, towels and a small starter set of essentials
• Smart TVs in living room and both bedrooms
• Wi‑Fi for planning and streaming

📍 Location Highlights
• Minutes to parks, greenways, and local shopping
• Downtown/Broadway — live music, dining, and nightlife ~7 miles
• Five Points & East Nashville — craft coffee, breweries, eateries
• Nissan Stadium, Ryman Auditorium, and Music Row — quick drives

🚗 Parking, Safety & Notes
• Parking is available for up to 2 vehicle(s) in the private garage
• This is a multi‑level townhouse — stairs required to access all levels and rooftop
• Laundry: Private washer and dryer in home
• Wi‑Fi: Provided; speeds may vary by carrier and usage
• Pets: This home is not pet friendly. If there is found evidence of an animal's presence during your stay or post check‑out, an additional cleaning fee will be charged
• Check‑in time is 4:00 PM and checkout time is 10:00 AM
